## Kreative Technologies, LLC - Senior Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://kreative-technologies-llc.breezy.hr/p/47b87be84870-senior-software-engineer)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer designing scalable software solutions for Kreative Technologies. Developing production code, improving architecture, and mentoring engineering teams remotely.
Senior Software Engineer building scalable software for Kreative Technologies
- Salary: $85,850 - $95,389 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Azure, Cloud, Java, Microservices, Python
- Designs software architecture and components for new and existing systems
- Develops, tests and deploys high-quality production code
- Leads technical design reviews and code reviews
- Improves system performance, scalability and security
- Builds and maintains automated tests and CI/CD pipelines
- Mentors software engineers and shares best practices
- Works with product, test and operations teams to deliver releases
- Performs other duties as assigned
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field required
- 5+ years of software engineering experience
- Strong experience with Java, C#, Python or a similar language
- Experience with software design patterns, APIs and relational databases
- Experience with Git, CI/CD and Agile development
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work independently in a remote environment
- Continually required to use common office equipment including but not limited to computers, phones, scanners and printers

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer designing scalable software solutions for Kreative Technologies. Developing production code, improving architecture, and mentoring engineering teams remotely.
Senior Software Engineer building scalable software for Kreative Technologies
Role description:
• Designs software architecture and components for new and existing systems
• Develops, tests and deploys high-quality production code
• Leads technical design reviews and code reviews
• Improves system performance, scalability and security
• Builds and maintains automated tests and CI/CD pipelines
• Mentors software engineers and shares best practices
• Works with product, test and operations teams to deliver releases
• Performs other duties as assigned
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field required

• Strong experience with Java, C#, Python or a similar language
• Experience with software design patterns, APIs and relational databases
